title: Bounded utility reasoning and action consistency in local model agents

claim_limits: The earlier single-model pilot observed 3/12 zero-regret episodes and 0/12 combined comprehension passes; those counts motivate, but do not confirm, these hypotheses.
Model actions do not establish human strategic behavior, a new equilibrium, or a trading edge.
Payoff explanations without measured source-bound action and oracle evidence remain untested.
An oracle diagnostic is not an independent replication or scientific promotion.

research_question.text: In disclosed binary-action eight-round public-goods games against fixed scripted opponents, when do local LLM agents choose actions consistent with an explicitly stated own-payoff or joint-payoff objective, and can bounded oracle and negative-control tests distinguish payoff arithmetic, seat binding, and lookahead errors? Treat prior instrument measurements as motivation only when their exact receipt is available; otherwise mark them unknown.

topics.text: Prior local-model instrument observation: 12/12 pilot episodes complete, 3/12 zero-regret, and 0/12 combined comprehension passed. Source: /home/decross1/projects/a_bgt_rsi_v2_artifacts/2026-09-15/lab-eight-hour/known-opponent-utility/qfn-followon-known-opponent-lab8h-a/admission.json, raw SHA-256 824403c23c6969eeb1e2cbc11c4ec2c5222cf7ff2123cbc867427868042bcee1. These counts motivate a new falsifiable hypothesis; they do not establish human behavior, an equilibrium, or a trading edge. If the receipt cannot be verified, call the prior observation unknown. Against the same disclosed eight-round scripted public-goods opponent and binary action menu, propose a bounded test of whether a local LLM agent chooses oracle-consistent actions more often when it computes exact focal and pooled payoffs correctly. Freeze the objective and script, prespecify separate arithmetic and full-horizon regret outcomes, attempted and valid denominators, and a scripted analytical best-response comparator.

These counts motivate a new falsifiable hypothesis; they do not establish human behavior, an equilibrium, or a trading edge. If the receipt cannot be verified, call the prior observation unknown. For fresh disclosed binary-action public-goods tuples with the same payoff rule and local LLM policy, propose a matched test of whether a seat-indexed action table versus a word-list representation changes exact focal-seat payoff, pooled payoff, and oracle action-choice agreement. Keep seat order and objective explicit, use a label-permutation negative control, and prespecify per-view and per-seat attempted denominators.
